item.title: This Asus 1440p/300Hz gaming monitor is $70 off, near its all-time low
item.description:
Source: PCWorld Pre-analysis score: 0.84
NOW $70 OFF Asus TUF Gaming monitor 27 inches, 1440p/300Hz, with Nvidia G-Sync View Deal The right monitor can turn any mid setup into one you love using day in and day out—and you don’t have to pay much for it. Whether you’re looking for an extra display for your multi-monitor workstation or just wanting to step up your cheap 1080p to 1440p on a budget, this Asus TUF gaming monitor is a solid pick. You can grab it now for $199 at Amazon , down from its usual $269 and only a few bucks more than its all-time lowest price. The Asus TUF VG27AQM5A has a modest 27-inch diagonal with a crisp 2560×1440 resolution, which is a big improvement over the fuzzy 1080p displays of yesteryear. Even nicer is the 300Hz refresh rate, allowing you to experience up to 300 frames per second for ultra-fluid motion. And with the 0.3ms response time and Nvidia G-Sync compatibility, you end up with super low blurring and extra sharp gaming visuals. Just note that you’ll need a machine capable of pumping out that many frames per second to take full advantage of the refresh rate. But even if you can only manage in the 100s, this monitor is still a solid choice—those frames will look great and you’ll have room if you ever upgrade. Other trade-offs to consider with this monitor: the stock stand only supports basic tilting and swiveling with no height adjustments, so you’ll probably want to mount it on a VESA 100×100 arm; the built-in 2W speakers are tinny and terrible; the brightness is weak at 300 nits and color depth is unimpressive; and it’s slow to wake from sleep. If none of that bothers you, this 1440p/300Hz monitor for just $199 is a great deal. If you aren’t fully sold on it, check out our picks for the best gaming monitors for more options.

item.title: Own Visual Studio Pro 2026 and learn to code for $33
item.description:
Source: PCWorld Pre-analysis score: 0.84
TL;DR: Get a lifetime license to Visual Studio Professional 2026 plus 15 coding courses for $32.97 (MSRP $1,999.99). Learning to program usually means paying for courses in one place and a professional IDE in another. This bundle pairs a lifetime license to Microsoft Visual Studio Professional 2026 with 15 coding courses, and it’s on sale for $32.97 (MSRP $1,999.99) through October 20. Python lessons start at the beginner level and work up to building Flask websites, scraping data, and automating a browser. Other courses teach C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL databases, Flutter mobile apps, and Ruby on Rails, plus how to connect to OpenAI’s API. Anyone working toward a Salesforce Platform App Builder certification gets exam prep, and a Unity game course teaches kids as young as 7. Everything you learn can go straight into Visual Studio 2026. You can write and debug .NET and C++ apps for Windows, Linux, and containers, and the C++ course even walks through debugging memory in Visual Studio. IntelliCode learns patterns from your codebase and suggests the next line or block, so you type less and catch more bugs. Live Share lets a teammate or mentor join your session to edit and debug without cloning the repo. Learn new programming languages and write them in an IDE you own for life. Through October 20 at 11:59 p.m. PT, you can get the Microsoft Visual Studio Professional 2026 + The Premium Learn to Code Certification Bundle on sale for $32.97 (MSRP $1,999.99).
